snippet.title: CARNIVORE! - a SHEEP HORROR Game - OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
YOU ARE A SHEEP!

You work at a restaurant with a bunch of other ANIMAL CRITTERS.

But, you're on the MENU, and are DELICIOUS!

Can you survive your SHIFT?

Carnivore! is a fully-animated HORROR COMEDY ADVENTURE, and it will release on my itch.io site MAY 28th, 2026!

Tune into https://cattrigger.itch.io on the day to play the game yourself!
